name: Gate B12
description: Boarding gate for short and medium haul departures, served by two airlines on a rotating schedule.
directions: From the main security checkpoint, follow signs for Piers A-C, take the moving walkway 250m, then turn right at Pier B junction. Gate B12 is the fourth gate on the left.
accessibility: Step-free access; wheelchair-accessible boarding ramp available on request at the gate desk.

name: Terminal 1 Check-in Area
description: Main check-in hall for international flights, with 40 self-service kiosks and 12 staffed desks.
directions: Enter through the main terminal entrance; check-in row is directly ahead, rows A to F.
accessibility: Priority check-in lane (Row A) for passengers with reduced mobility; induction loop available at desks 1-4.

name: Baggage Claim Hall
description: Arrivals baggage hall with 8 reclaim belts, serving all inbound flights.
directions: Follow 'Baggage Claim' signage from the arrivals gate corridor down one level via escalator or lift.
accessibility: Lift access from all arrival gates; accessible reclaim belt positions marked near belts 1 and 2.

name: Security Control - Terminal 1
description: Central security screening checkpoint for all Terminal 1 departing passengers.
directions: Located directly past the check-in hall; follow overhead 'Security/Departures' signage.
accessibility: Dedicated accessible lane; staff assistance available for passengers who cannot stand for extended periods.

name: Central Information Desk
floor_zone: Level 0, Main Hall, opposite Row C
description: General passenger information point for flight status, directions, and airport services.
directions: Located in the centre of the main terminal hall, marked with an illuminated 'i' sign.
accessibility: Lowered counter section for wheelchair users; multilingual staff available.

name: Lost and Found Office
description: Office handling reports of lost personal items and mishandled baggage claims.
directions: Exit the baggage claim hall via the side corridor signed 'Lost Property'; office is 30m on the right.
accessibility: Ground floor, step-free access.

name: Skyline Airport Lounge
description: Pay-per-use and membership lounge offering seating, food, beverages, and workstations.
directions: Take the escalator up from the Pier B junction; the lounge entrance is directly ahead on Level 2.
accessibility: Lift access available; accessible restroom inside the lounge.

name: Terminal Food Court
description: Food court with 10 outlets offering local and international cuisine, and seating for 200.
directions: Take the escalator up from the main hall near Row D; food court is straight ahead.
accessibility: Lift access; accessible seating areas near the main entrance.

name: Airport Train Station Connection
description: Direct rail link connecting the airport to the city centre, regional, and national rail networks.
directions: Follow 'Train Station' signage from the arrivals hall down via escalator, lift, or stairs to Level -1.
accessibility: Lift access to all platforms; tactile paving on platform edges.

name: Taxi Pickup Zone
description: Designated taxi rank directly outside the arrivals hall, with a dispatcher on duty at peak times.
directions: Exit the arrivals hall through doors marked 'Exit C - Taxis'; the rank is immediately outside.
accessibility: Step-free access; accessible taxis available on request at the dispatcher point.

name: Prayer Room
description: Quiet, multi-faith prayer and reflection room with separate areas and washing facilities.
directions: From the Food Court, follow signage for 'Quiet Room / Prayer Room' along the east corridor.
accessibility: Step-free access; accessible washing facilities provided.

name: Special Assistance Desk
floor_zone: Level 0, Main Hall, near Row A
description: Dedicated desk coordinating mobility assistance, wheelchairs, and support for passengers with disabilities.
directions: Located beside check-in Row A, marked with the international access symbol.
accessibility: Fully accessible desk with lowered counter and hearing loop.

name: Duty Free Area
description: Duty-free retail area offering perfumes, spirits, electronics, and souvenirs.
directions: Immediately after Security Control, follow the main departures corridor.
accessibility: Wide, step-free aisles suitable for wheelchairs and prams.

name: Currency Exchange Desk
description: Foreign currency exchange and travel money services.
directions: Located near the Central Information Desk in the main terminal hall.
accessibility: Ground floor, step-free access.

name: Car Rental Centre
description: Shared desk for major car rental providers with direct access to the short-stay car park.
directions: Follow 'Car Rental' signage from the arrivals hall to Level -1, opposite the train platforms.
accessibility: Lift access; accessible vehicles available on request with 24-hour notice.

name: Gate A05
description: Boarding gate primarily used for domestic and short-haul European departures.
directions: From Security Control, follow signs for Pier A; Gate A05 is the second gate on the right.
accessibility: Step-free access; accessible seating near the gate desk.

name: Pharmacy and Medical Point
floor_zone: Level 0, Main Hall, near Row F
description: Airport pharmacy and first-aid point staffed by qualified medical personnel.
directions: Located near check-in Row F, marked with a red cross symbol.
accessibility: Fully accessible; wheelchair available on request.

name: Terminal 2 Check-in Area
description: Secondary check-in hall serving low-cost and charter carriers, with 20 self-service kiosks.
directions: Enter through the Terminal 2 entrance; check-in counters are directly ahead.
accessibility: Priority lane for passengers with reduced mobility at Counter 1.

name: Pet Relief Area
description: Designated outdoor area for service animals and pets travelling with passengers.
directions: Exit via Exit C; the pet relief area is signposted 20m to the left of the taxi rank.
accessibility: Step-free, outdoor gravel surface.

name: Flight Information Display Board - Terminal 1
description: Large digital display board showing real-time departure and arrival status for all flights.
directions: Visible immediately upon entering the main terminal hall from any entrance.
accessibility: High-contrast display; audio announcements accompany major status changes.
